# Thorne

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c15 P89](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0089), [v1 c22 P3](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0003)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolteacher at Brierley school  <sub>[v1 c22 P3](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0003), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)</sub>

## Appearance

Agnes Thorne is a young woman who possesses light, curly hair and captivating eyes. She dresses in a gorgeous, refined manner and wears fashionable puffed sleeves.

_Sources: [v1 c17 P8](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0008), [v1 c24 P2](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0002), [v1 c24 P8](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0008)_

## Personality

Miss Thorne is an intelligent, compassionate, and gentle teacher who commands respect and affection from her students without needing to use physical discipline. She is open-minded and encourages her pupils to think independently, explore nature, and evaluate their own work. Her supportive guidance helps her students flourish academically and morally.

_Sources: [v1 c23 P31](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0031), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 c24 P2](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0002), [v1 c26 P21](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0021), [v1 c31 P12](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0012), [v1 c31 P25](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0025)_

## History

Miss Agnes Thorne was hired as the new teacher for the Brierley school, becoming the first female instructor in the village. Upon taking charge, she introduced innovative methods such as field trips to study nature, physical culture exercises, and bi-weekly student recitations. She established an advanced class after school to help her most proficient pupils prepare for the Regent's Academy Entrance Examinations. Although she received a job offer in her home district, she chose to stay in Brierley to guide her class through their final year. Under her tutelage, every member of her Entrance class passed their examinations, with two of her students, Nell Harcourt and Hugh Carrow, tying for the highest marks in the province. Miss Thorne subsequently accepted a position in a grade school in her home district, leaving Brierley amidst the tears and deep gratitude of her students.

_Sources: [v1 c22 P3](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0003), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 c24 P6](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0006), [v1 c24 P8](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0008), [v1 c24 P10](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0010), [v1 c30 P14](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0014), [v1 c30 P29](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0029), [v1 c30 P32](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0032), [v1 c31 P0](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0000), [v1 c32 P39](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0039)_
